title: API key rotation and scopes
content_markdown:
## API key rotation
Rotate keys regularly. Create a new key, update clients, then revoke the old key. Scopes limit access to specific APIs.
content_text: API key rotation Rotate keys regularly. Create a new key, update clients, then revoke the old key. Scopes limit access to specific APIs.

title: HTTP rate limits and backoff
content_markdown:
## Rate limits
429 responses include `Retry-After`. Use exponential backoff with jitter. Burst limits differ by endpoint and plan tier.
content_text: Rate limits 429 responses include Retry-After. Use exponential backoff with jitter. Burst limits differ by endpoint and plan tier.

title: Webhook signing verification
content_markdown:
## Webhook signing
Verify `X-NWP-Signature` using HMAC-SHA256 over the raw request body. Reject timestamps older than 5 minutes.
content_text: Webhook signing Verify X-NWP-Signature using HMAC-SHA256 over the raw request body. Reject timestamps older than 5 minutes.

title: Create a charge
content_markdown:
## Create a charge
POST `/v1/charges` with amount, currency, and payment_method. Idempotency-Key prevents duplicate charges on retries.
content_text: Create a charge POST /v1/charges with amount, currency, and payment_method. Idempotency-Key prevents duplicate charges on retries.

title: Tool calling contract
content_markdown:
## Tool calling
Tools must declare JSON schema for inputs and return structured outputs. Include `trace_id` for correlating model runs.
content_text: Tool calling Tools must declare JSON schema for inputs and return structured outputs. Include trace_id for correlating model runs.

title: Chunking and overlap recommendations
content_markdown:
## Chunking
Prefer 500–900 token chunks with ~10% overlap. Preserve headings and code blocks. Avoid splitting tables mid-row.
content_text: Chunking Prefer 500–900 token chunks with about 10% overlap. Preserve headings and code blocks. Avoid splitting tables mid-row.

title: Postgres vacuum and freeze runbook
content_markdown:
## Vacuum freeze
Use `VACUUM (ANALYZE)` during low traffic. For bloat, consider `pg_repack`. Monitor autovacuum logs and wraparound age.
content_text: Vacuum freeze Use VACUUM (ANALYZE) during low traffic. For bloat, consider pg_repack. Monitor autovacuum logs and wraparound age.

title: Python SDK quickstart

## Quickstart
Install `pip install frostbyte`. Configure `FROSTBYTE_API_KEY`. Create a client and call `client.files.upload()`.

title: Regions and data residency
content_markdown:
## Data residency
Choose a region per workspace. Some services are global (audit logs). Moving regions requires support-assisted migration.
content_text: Data residency Choose a region per workspace. Some services are global (audit logs). Moving regions requires support-assisted migration.

title: SSRF prevention checklist
content_markdown:
## SSRF checklist
Validate URLs, block link-local ranges, resolve DNS twice, and enforce allowlists. Log fetch target and response size caps.
content_text: SSRF checklist Validate URLs, block link-local ranges, resolve DNS twice, and enforce allowlists. Log fetch target and response size caps.

title: Kafka ingest: exactly-once semantics
content_markdown:
## Exactly-once
Enable idempotent producers and transactional writes. Consumers should commit offsets after durable sink writes to avoid duplicates.
content_text: Exactly-once Enable idempotent producers and transactional writes. Consumers should commit offsets after durable sink writes to avoid duplicates.

title: SQL date/time functions
content_markdown:
## Date/time
Use `date_trunc`, `to_timestamp`, and `at_time_zone`. Timestamps are stored in UTC; formatting occurs at query time.
content_text: Date/time Use date_trunc, to_timestamp, and at_time_zone. Timestamps are stored in UTC; formatting occurs at query time.

title: Markdown tables conventions
content_markdown:
## Tables
Align columns for readability. Avoid nested tables. Prefer short cell values; link out to details. Keep header row explicit.
content_text: Tables Align columns for readability. Avoid nested tables. Prefer short cell values; link out to details. Keep header row explicit.

title: Markdown tables conventions (rev 2026-04)
content_markdown:
## Tables
Use pipe tables. Keep cells under ~80 chars. For wide data, publish CSV and link it. Always escape literal `|` characters.
content_text: Tables Use pipe tables. Keep cells under about 80 chars. For wide data, publish CSV and link it. Always escape literal | characters.

title: Point-in-time restore
content_markdown:
## PITR
Keep WAL archives for at least 7 days. Restore base backup, then replay WAL to target timestamp. Validate with checksums.
content_text: PITR Keep WAL archives for at least 7 days. Restore base backup, then replay WAL to target timestamp. Validate with checksums.

title: Bootstrap with GitHub App
content_markdown:
## Bootstrap
Install the GitHub App, create a `bootstrap` repository, and apply manifests via `orbitctl sync`. Webhooks must reach `/events`.

title: Error handling: rate limited
content_markdown:
## Rate limited
When you receive `429`, pause and retry after the provided delay. Retries should be capped; log request IDs for support.
content_text: Rate limited When you receive 429, pause and retry after the provided delay. Retries should be capped; log request IDs for support.
